tools.name: ragic_get_sheet_schema
tools.description: Return a sheet's field definitions: field ids, names, types and subtables, without records. Use it first to learn the field ids. Ragic allows this only to account managers. Ragic API: GET /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/metadata/schema.

tools.name: ragic_list_records
tools.description: List records of one sheet, with optional filters, ordering and paging. Each where filter compares one field by its numeric id. Returns an array of {recordId, fields} in Ragic order, up to a size budget; when hasMore is true, call again with offset set to nextOffset. Ragic API: GET /<account>/<tab>/<

tools.name: ragic_get_record
tools.description: Return one record of a sheet by its record id, with all top-level fields. Ragic API: GET /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record>.

tools.name: ragic_create_record
tools.description: Create one record in a sheet. Writes the given top-level field values; the API key's user needs write access to the sheet. Not undoable through this tool: use ragic_delete_record to remove it. Ragic API: POST /<account>/<tab>/<sheet> (JSON).

tools.name: ragic_update_record
tools.description: Change the given top-level fields of one record; other fields stay as they are. Subtable rows are not changed by this tool. Ragic API: POST /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record> (JSON).

tools.name: ragic_delete_record
tools.description: Delete one record from a sheet by its record id. The record is removed from the sheet. Ragic API: DELETE /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record>.

tools.name: ragic_set_record_lock
tools.description: Lock a record so users cannot edit it, or unlock it. The permission rules are the same as in the Ragic form. Ragic API: POST /<account>/<tab>/<sheet>/<record>?lock or ?unlock.
